text: Lab 03 Tasks Task 1: The Tiny Fingerprint (Linear - Scale) • Scenario: You are a detective analyzing a digital fingerprint from a crime scene, but it is too small to read. Task: Write a script to manually build a 2x2 scaling matrix. Enlarge the fingerprint by on the x-axis and on the y-axis. Calculate how to keep the fingerprint perfectly centered on the screen after it grows. Task 2: The Dizzy Satellite (Linear - Rotation) • Scenario: A weather satellite bumped into space debris and took photos of a city rotated at a steep 45-degree angle. Task: Formulate a 2x2 rotation matrix using sine and cosine functions. Spin the image back to true north. Manually calculate the new image dimensions so the corners of the city do not get chopped off during the spin. Task 3: The Fast Train Barcode (Linear - Shear) • • Scenario: A scanner took a photo of a barcode on a fast-moving train, causing the image to look slanted to the right. Task: Construct a 2x2 shear matrix to " push " the pixels horizontally. Shift the slanted lines back into a perfect rectangle so the barcode can be read correctly . Task 4: The Hidden Treasure Map (Affine - Translation) • Scenario: A digital map is misaligned. The "X marks the spot" is hidden off the screen, exactly 15@ pixels to the left and 80 pixels up. Task: Upgrade your matrices from 2x2 to 3x3 to allow for movement. Create a translation matrix and apply it to shift every pixel, sliding the map safely back into the visible frame. Talha Shahid II Page
